title: How Microsegmentation namespaces, tags and resource tags are configured and which are locked

prose.label: Related.
prose.text: The Tag Management page is in [[zms.portal]] and resource groups that use tags in [[zms.resources]].

checks.do: Whether the namespace is custom, cloud or ML before trying to edit or delete a tag or namespace.

resource-tag-delete-scope.title: Does the 'at any time' resource tag delete apply to tags in cloud and ML namespaces?
resource-tag-delete-scope.detail: The resource tag deletion page allows deleting individual resource tags at any time from the resource drawer (Delete Tag window), while the tag deletion page allows deletion only for custom-type tags and says admins cannot delete tags within cloud and ML namespaces. These may be different objects (Delete Tag versus Delete Tag Key) and the captured pages do not settle whether the resource drawer flow is limited by namespace type.

namespace-types.statement: Namespaces are where tags are created; admins can create custom namespaces, while ML and cloud namespaces are generated from the organization's data.

quotes: Namespaces are the areas in which tags for Microsegmentation are created.
You can create your own custom namespaces or allow machine learning (ML) and cloud namespaces to be generated from your organization's data.

cloud-ml-namespaces-locked.statement: Cloud and ML namespaces cannot be edited or deleted; custom namespaces can.

quotes: While you cannot edit or delete cloud and machine learning (ML) namespaces, you can edit and delete custom namespaces.
You cannot delete cloud and machine learning (ML) namespaces.

cloud-ml-tags-locked.statement: Cloud and ML tags are autogenerated and cannot be manually configured, and tags within cloud and ML namespaces cannot be deleted; custom tags can be edited or deleted.

quotes: Cloud or machine learning (ML) tags are autogenerated from your organization's data, and you cannot manually configure them.
You can edit or delete custom tags at any time.
Admins cannot delete tags within cloud and machine learning (ML) namespaces.

custom-tag-fields.statement: A custom tag has a Key, an optional Description and comma-separated Values, and can be assigned to resource groups.

quotes: Admins can create tags for custom namespaces in Microsegmentation that can then be assigned to resource groups.
Key: Enter a key name for the custom tag.
Description: (Optional) Add information to describe the tag.
Values: Add individual values, separated by commas, for the tag.

resource-tag-fields.statement: A tag added to a resource on the Resources VM page takes a Namespace, a Key and Value(s), and resource tags are used as criteria when configuring resource groups.

quotes: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Resources VM.
Tags are resource components used when configuring criteria for resource groups.
Namespace: Select a namespace for the tag.
Key: Select a key name to title the tag.
Value: Select value components for which the tag qualifies.

resource-tag-delete.statement: The resource tag deletion page says individual resource tags can be deleted manually at any time from the Tags section in the resource drawer on the Resources VM page, and deleting one requires entering CONFIRM in the Delete Tag window.

quotes: You can manually delete individual tags from the list at any time.
From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Resources VM.
In the resource drawer, click Tags.
The Delete Tag window appears.
Enter CONFIRM.

prereq-policy-enforcement.statement: Configuring namespaces, tags and resource tags lists enabling policy enforcement for the organization as a prerequisite.

quotes: Enable policy enforcement for your organization.
Enable policy enforcement for your organization.
Enable policy enforcement for your organization.
